summary: Set idle_aap: true in the AnsibleAutomationPlatform spec to scale down all AAP deployments and StatefulSets (for upgrades, migrations or disaster recovery); set it to false to scale back up.
questions: How do I scale down all AAP deployments on OpenShift?
Stop AAP pods for maintenance with the operator

answer_card.title: Scale AAP down and up
answer_card.answer_md:
Edit the AnsibleAutomationPlatform and add under `spec:`:
```yaml
idle_aap: true    # false scales back up
```
